title.narrative: Stopim Hevi, Kamapim Bel Isi-Prevent Violence, Promote Peace

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is that civil society in target communities address issues of conflict and violence, strengthening a culture of peaceful and inclusive development, which is directly aligned to the EU global objective to enable civil society organisations to engage as actors of development and peaceful resolution of conflicts. The specific objective is that civil society in Central and Morobe Provinces and NCD is equipped with skills and knowledge to prevent, respond to and minimise the impact of conflict and violence, contributing to the EUs specific objective to support communities and the society as a whole in addressing conflict and violence, and strengthening a culture of peace and peaceful resolution of divergent interests - 'Holim Bel Isi na Gutpela Sindaun'. This will be done through three strategic and complementary interventions, including: i) utilising the growing youth population to act as Peace & Protection Champions, leading peer education, advocacy and awareness raising activities aimed at promoting peace, preventing violence and understanding of the justice system; ii) building capacity at Village and District Court level on systems and procedures, particularly around implementation of key acts related to conflict and violence including the Lukautim Pikinini (2015) Act; the Juvenile Justice Act (2014); and the Family Protection Act (2013); and iii) working with local civil society to both create an enabling environment and strengthen their capacity to provide peacebuilding, violence prevention and survivor support services.
